newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goodyear, Bridgestone mull purchases in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear, Bridgestone mull purchases in Singapore.

text.p: Major tyre manufacturers Goodyear and Bridgestone were said to be seeking some cargoes in the Singapore rubber market on Wednesday while other dealers engaged in a bout of shortcovering, dealers said.
"Goodyear is nosing around and taking a look at prices. I hear Bridgestone is also in the market. There's been some modest shortcovering for all the rubber grades today," a trader said.

Goodyear and Bridgestone were said to be seeking forward deliveries of TSR20 rubber although dealers said they were not sure if deals had been concluded by the two companies. Negotiations were said to be still ongoing, dealers said.
Another European tyre manufacturer is said to be also looking for nearby supplies of TSR20 rubber. "I understand they are looking for material," a dealer said.
"There was some fairly moderate shortcovering that was done in the market by local dealers trying to lock in their positions," another dealer said.

At around 0945 GMT, September RSS3 was seen at 92.00 U.S. cents a kg from 91.50 cents. August RSS1 was seen at 129.25 Singapore cents (90 U.S. cents) a kg from 128.25 cents. October TSR20 was seen at 99 U.S. cents a kg from 98.25 cents.
